tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue, sampled from the IM logo and brochure. Hero colour: colour-block panels, primary buttons, process badges, accent words in headlines, stat numbers. As text: 8.13:1 on white, 7.12:1 on paper, 7.15:1 on blue-pale, 6.53:1 on butter.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Deep navy for dark sections and the footer. Carries white (16.81:1), butter (13.50:1) and blue-sky (9.46:1) text. Never put blue text on navy (2.07:1).

tokens.name: blue-mid
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for primary buttons (white label 5.58:1) and link colour on light grounds: 5.58:1 on white, 4.88:1 on paper, 4.91:1 on blue-pale. Not for text on blue or navy.

tokens.name: blue-pale
tokens.usage: Very pale blue tint for quiet section backgrounds, image placeholders and selected states. Carries ink (16.21:1), blue (7.15:1), blue-mid (4.91:1).

tokens.name: blue-sky
tokens.usage: Secondary text, links and small labels on navy (9.46:1). Intentional addition: navy needs a muted text tone that stays blue. On blue it is 4.58:1 — fine for 16px+ body, avoid below that.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Default page ground and cards; text colour on blue (8.13:1) and navy (16.81:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white paper tone sampled from the brochure. Alternating section ground, hero ground, the light half of split colour-block layouts. Carries ink 16.12:1, ink-muted 7.79:1, blue 7.12:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black for headings and body copy on white, paper, blue-pale, butter and butter-soft (≥14.79:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, keyword sublines, captions and metadata on white (8.90:1), paper (7.79:1), butter-soft (8.00:1), butter (7.15:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Soft hairline dividers between rows, sections and cards on white and paper. Decorative only (1.46:1) — never the only boundary of a form control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Brochure rule grey. Input borders, service-grid hairlines and any divider that must be seen: 3.56:1 on white, 3.12:1 on paper (meets 3:1 for UI).

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on blue and navy panels (the thin white rule from the brochure's contact page). Decorative.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Butter-yellow accent. On blue/navy: eyebrows, highlighted words, stat labels, focus rings (6.53:1 on blue, 13.50:1 on navy). As a fill: small highlight bars and hover fills behind ink/navy text. Use sparingly — blue stays the hero.

tokens.name: butter-soft
tokens.usage: Softer butter ground for long, text-heavy blocks (About, Testimonials). Carries ink 16.55:1, ink-muted 8.00:1, blue 7.30:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors only (6.57:1 on white, 5.75:1 on paper). Always paired with an error message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue or blue-mid fill (button labels, badge numerals).

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Primary text on navy.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on white, paper and blue-pale. On navy use blue-sky; on blue use white with underline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds: 2px solid, 3px offset (8.13:1 on white, 7.12:1 on paper).

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on blue and navy grounds (6.53:1 on blue, 13.50:1 on navy).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline only, uppercase. Fluid: 60px at 360px wide → 136px at 1440px (clamp(60px, 9.4vw, 136px)).

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Section titles that open a major chapter (Services, Our Work, Let's Create). Mobile 56px.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Panel titles inside colour blocks, CTA headlines, mobile menu links (48px). Mobile 36px.

styles.name: display-4
styles.usage: Case-study client names, lightbox counters. Mobile 30px.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat blocks (8+, 100+, 15M). Count up on first view. Mobile 64px.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Process step titles (uppercase), large card headings. Mobile 24px.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card titles (Work, Testimonials names at 18px). Mobile 20px.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Service card titles in blue, uppercase — the brochure's 'What We Do' style. Mobile 17px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above every display title. Ink on light grounds, butter on blue/navy. Mobile 13px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A Mumbai-based digital marketing and branding agency.
styles.usage: Hero sub-line and section intros, max 56ch. Mobile 18px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Strategy, branding and content that grows with you.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Keyword sublines, nav links, card descriptions, form labels.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: They gave our brand a new beginning.
styles.usage: Testimonial quotes and gallery captions in the Events section. Mobile 19px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and chip labels. Sentence case for buttons, uppercase for chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, tags, legal lines, footer small print. Never below 13px.

spacing.note: 4px base. Section padding is space-8 (64px) on phones and space-10 (128px) from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, dot offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, eyebrow-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter, card inner stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, gutter at 768px, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from 768px, desktop gutter, title-to-content gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between grid blocks, footer column gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones; hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding at 768px.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding on desktop; breathing room before the footer.

radius.note: Squared, like the brochure. Nothing rounder than radius-md except the 7px label dot and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Colour-block panels, section bands, images in the work grid, service grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, gallery images, client tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Label chip, process badges, testimonial cards, lightbox frame.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The 7px dot in the label chip and process rows only.

shadow.note: Mostly flat: hairlines and colour blocks carry hierarchy. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for cards and tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Sticky nav once scrolled; inputs on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Work card and testimonial card on hover (with a 4px lift).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Lightbox image, mobile menu sheet.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: write phone styles bare, then min-width queries. Most traffic arrives from Instagram on phones, so design at 375px first.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: 2-column client wall, side-by-side buttons.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: 8 columns, 2-column service grid, stats in a row.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop nav replaces the menu button; 12 columns; split hero.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide: container hits its max; display sizes reach their caps.

layout.note: Grid: 4 columns on phones, 8 from bp-md, 12 from bp-lg.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width including gutters.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Long-form text blocks (About, case-study body).

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Side padding and column gap on phones.

tokens.name: gutter-md
tokens.usage: Side padding and column gap from bp-md.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Side padding and column gap from bp-lg.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Nav bar height on phones.

tokens.name: nav-height-lg
tokens.usage: Nav bar height from bp-lg.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, client tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons and chips.

tokens.name: rule-bold
tokens.usage: The thick blue rule under hero headlines (from the brochure cover).

tokens.name: motif-faint
tokens.usage: Circuit-line motif behind content on light grounds.

tokens.name: motif-inverse
tokens.usage: Circuit-line motif on blue and navy panels.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Navy lightbox backdrop opacity.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky navigation.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: z-lightbox
tokens.usage: Gallery lightbox.
